description: This PHP source file defines a command class 'AddRolePermissionCommand' used within the OrangeHRM system to add permissions for user roles to data groups. It includes command configuration, interactive prompts, and SQL generation for permission management.

classes.name: AddRolePermissionCommand
classes.description: A console command class for adding role-based permissions to data groups within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up command description, arguments, and options for the CLI command.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the command with SymfonyStyle for user interaction.

methods.name: interact
methods.description: Provides interactive prompts to collect required command input from the user.

methods.name: getDataGroupAutocompleteQuestion
methods.description: Creates an autocomplete question for selecting a data group, with validation.

methods.name: getUserRoleAutocompleteQuestion
methods.description: Creates an autocomplete question for selecting a user role, with validation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command: retrieves inputs, creates permission entity, optionally persists, and outputs SQL snippets.

methods.name: printDataGroupPermissionTable
methods.description: Displays a table of existing permissions for the selected data group.

methods.name: printDataGroupPermissionSQL
methods.description: Outputs example SQL queries to set data group ID, user role ID, and insert permission records.

methods.name: printBlock
methods.description: Outputs a formatted block of SQL or message within the console.
